html:
JEE, NEET, and KVPY are one of the most challenging entrance exams in India. With the level of difficulty of these papers soaring high, JEE, NEET and KVPY serve as the platform to measure, analyze and get at par with the top talents across India.

Now, JEE and KVPY are quite similar, especially considering their syllabus. Hence, this becomes an excellent exercise for the students who plan on applying for both entrance exams.

Students must bear in mind that the selection rate of KVPY is 1.8-2% only, making the exam relatively tougher than JEE mains. This makes it important to understand the paper pattern of KVPY well in advance if you wish to crack the examination.

The preparation for JEE examination requires candidates to study subjects including physics, chemistry, and mathematics from classes 11th and 12th. There are two stages of JEE examination - JEE Mains and Advanced. This examination allows students to get admission in top engineering colleges including IIT.

KVPY’s syllabus includes Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for students to study. The syllabus consists of topics from 10th, 11th and 12th grades. The examination’s question paper is divided into two parts that has four sub-sections for the mentioned subjects each.

Students preparing for NEET examination, should be aware of the syllabus before starting out their planning. This will help them ace the exam with ease. NEET syllabus includes topics from Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, from grades 11th and 12th.

Preparing for entrance examination requires proper planning. Start your journey early so that you can crack these examinations with flying colors. However, do remember to refer to the right books while studying for these exams. Additionally, it is also important to look at previous year’s papers to have a fair idea about the paper pattern and level of difficulty of these examinations. We hope this article has been useful for you.

Good luck!
